name: L1 Regularization on Residual Grids
definition: $||R_t||_1$: L1 regularization applied to residual grid $R_t$ to ensure temporal continuity and minimize its magnitude.
summary: L1 Regularization on Residual Grids applies L1 penalties to temporal residual grids during dynamic radiance field optimization to enforce continuity and facilitate compression, distinguishing itself by explicitly targeting temporal residual structures.
